# open-game-skills

> Engine-neutral instructions for coding agents, not a game runtime. Select a task skill and an engine adapter; test the resulting game in its actual engine. This index is navigation, not a search-ranking guarantee.

## Start here
- [English overview](README.md)
- [简体中文](README.zh.md)
- [繁體中文](README.zh-Hant.md)
- [日本語](README.ja.md)
- [한국어](README.ko.md)
- [Dispatcher](skills/dispatcher/SKILL.md): route a task without loading every skill
- [Shared contract](skills/CONTRACT.md): inputs, outputs and evidence
- [Machine-readable catalog](skills/catalog.json)
